leaves.name: gaudronRemondThm14AnDeg
leaves.doc: gr-isogdeg, printed form: Gaudron-Remond, Duke Math. J. 163 (2014) Thm 1.4 (p. 2060; kappa and alpha(g) = 1024 g^3 p. 2058; read by the locator audit), over ZInQ.R3Residual.IsAnStableHeight (Faltings' normalization; the archimedean metric integrated over the complex manifold A_tau(C)^an, r3-residual), with the degree of the isogeny as a finite morphism: ZInQ.GRIsogDeg.finDeg phi = Mathlib's Scheme.Hom.finrank of phi at the generic point of the target (= [K(A):K(B)]). Replaces gaudronRemondThm14Printed via ZInQ.GRIsogDeg.gaudronRemondThm14Printed_of_anDeg: isogDeg_le_finDeg proves #ker(phi)(Kbar) <= finDeg phi for every isogeny over any field, then r3-residual's gaudronRemondThm14Printed_of_an with mumfordTorsionAlgClosed and uniformizationLeafAll_proof for T35.
